title.narrative: AU Closed Briefing Sessions on Sudan in 2025

description.narrative: The aim objective of the project is to establish a platform for informal discussions with the objective of advancing peace in Sudan and ending the war. Since the beginning of the conflict, there has been increasing evidence that it could spill over into neighbouring countries, leading to regional instability. The project aims to enhance coordination mechanisms among AU member states (and other stakeholders), develop informed policy recommendations, and foster a shared understanding of the conflict. This could eventually lead to peace and security in Sudan. The AU Closed Briefing Sessions on Sudan will be held in Addis Ababa. The AU hosted the first session in July 2025, and the feedback was positive. With support from Denmark, the AU will conduct an additional two sessions in partnership with the Institute for Security Studies (ISS). These sessions will focus on (1) conflict dynamics and the role of illicit arms, and (2) the implications of Sudan’s potential partition for regional and global stability. Participants in the sessions will include technical AU staff, AU member states, neighbouring countries of Sudan, regional actors, and key international partners. The main aim of the project is to establish a platform for informal discussions to advance peace in Sudan and develop informed policy recommendations for regional and international stakeholders.
